evidence.summary: The alert reports sustained pool saturation.
evidence.excerpt: zero idle database connections and pending borrowers for two minutes

evidence.summary: A large annual export started immediately before saturation.
All 20 connections were active and eight requests were waiting.
A request timed out while waiting for a connection.
evidence.excerpt: Connection is not available; request timed out after 3000ms

evidence.summary: The queue of waiting requests grew while the pool remained full.
The annual export query completed after about 18 seconds.
Pool capacity recovered immediately after the export completed.
The runbook defines the observed metrics as pool saturation.
evidence.excerpt: active equals maximum, idle is zero, and pending is greater than zero

evidence.summary: The runbook recommends correlating long queries with the saturation window.
evidence.excerpt: Compare the start and completion time of long-running queries with the saturation window.

timeline.summary: The connection pool reached its maximum and requests began waiting.
Pending connection borrowers rose from eight to 31.
Idle connections recovered after the annual export query completed.

observations.statement: The pool was saturated: active equaled maximum, idle was zero, and pending borrowers increased.
At least one API request returned 503 after timing out on connection checkout.
Pool recovery followed the completion of the long-running export query.

hypotheses.title: Long-running export work exhausted the connection pool
hypotheses.summary: The annual export overlapped the entire saturation window, and capacity returned immediately after it completed. This is strong correlation, but a query plan is still needed before calling it the root cause.

hypotheses.title: The database server was unavailable
hypotheses.summary: Connection checkout errors are compatible with an outage, but the export query completed and existing connections remained active, which weakens this hypothesis.

informationGaps.description: No query plan, lock-wait data, or database CPU metrics were provided for the export query.
The evidence does not show how many exports were running concurrently.

nextChecks.description: Capture the export query plan and lock waits before changing pool capacity.
Verify database availability and error rate during the saturation window.
